title: Must Jesus Bear the Cross Alone
lyrics: [G]Must Jesus bear the [C]cross alone, and [G]all the world go [D]free?
[G]No, there's a cross for [C]everyone, and [G]there's a cross [D7]for [G]me.
till He shall set me free;
and then go home my crown to wear,
for there's a crown for me.
with joy I'll cast my golden crown,
